subject: SableBank deployment & integration constraints — recap and next steps
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>

Subject: Recap: deployment options & integration constraints (SableBank)

Thanks again for the call earlier, Alice — good to meet the infra and security folks. Short recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned. Please flag anything I missed or misstated.

Summary of what we heard on the call:
- Workload split: transaction-processing (card + wire) needs the strictest controls; other analytics/embeddings use-cases are less sensitive.
- Primary integration constraints driving a private/dedicated decision:
  • SSO: SableBank requires SAML 2.0 IdP + SCIM provisioning for group sync and automated deprovisioning.
  • KMS/HSM: customer-managed keys are mandatory for transaction workloads; HSM-backed key management (FIPS 140-2) preferred.
  • Logging & retention: security wants immutable logs exported to your SIEM and retention configurable up to 7+ years for audit trails.
  • Network: VPC peering or PrivateLink; no public egress for transaction streams.
- Business preference: minimize immediate scope — pilot transaction sandbox on Dedicated capacity with KMS in their VPC if feasible; private control plane / on-prem looks likely if audit requires full separation.

Proposed next steps (pick items to start):
1) We will produce a short integration gap doc that maps our capabilities to your controls (SSO, SCIM, KMS/HSM, logging, network). (owner: Sergio)
2) Security RFI/RFP: please share the SableBank questionnaire; we can prefill and identify gaps. (owner: Alice + SableBank Sec)
3) Pilot plan: prepare a Dedicated pilot design that runs in your VPC with customer-managed KMS and log-forwarding to your SIEM. (owner: Monica / CS)
4) Timeline sync: brief technical working session next week to validate the pilot network and KMS approach. Proposed times: Tue 12/8 10:00–11:00 PST or Wed 12/9 14:00–15:00 PST.

Attachments: I attached our post-call integration checklist template — please drop any RFI items there and we’ll slot them into the gap doc.

Thanks — I’ll draft the gap doc by EOD Friday and loop in Priya for the technical details.

—

Subject: Re: Recap: deployment options & integration constraints (SableBank)

Thanks, Sergio — that matches our notes. A few clarifications and asks:

- We agree with a two-track approach. Not all workloads need Private. Our card/wire processing path needs either on-prem or a logically isolated deployment (Dedicated in our VPC with customer-managed KMS + HSM is acceptable for pilot).
- KMS detail: HSM-backed customer keys are required for production transaction flows. For the pilot we can accept a cloud KMS if we validate an HSM migration path and see evidence of key isolation.
- Logging/retention: security is aiming for 10 years for certain record types (transaction audit trails). If Redwood's platform can export immutable logs to our SIEM (Splunk) and support retention on our side, that will reduce friction.
- SSO: SAML + SCIM are mandatory; SCIM group attributes are critical because we map roles to group memberships.

Attached our security RFI PDF (redacted). We can also share a redline RFP if needed.

We’re tentatively fine with the proposed working session; Tue 12/8 10:00 PST works for our infra lead. Please include a short agenda (network/VPC, KMS, SCIM mapping).

—
Alice Nguyen
Director, Cloud Security | SableBank

Subject: RE: Recap: deployment options & integration constraints (SableBank)

Thanks — copying a recommended approach based on the constraints Alice shared and our current product capabilities. I’ll keep it high level so we can present it in the working session agenda.

Recommended two-track plan (technical summary):
1) Short-term pilot (4–6 weeks): Dedicated capacity deployed into SableBank-managed VPC (we support bring-your-own-VPC peering), customer-managed KMS using AWS CloudHSM or equivalent, log-forwarding via secure syslog/S3 to your Splunk ingestion endpoint. This gets you isolation + key ownership quickly.

2) Long-term option (if audit requires): Private deployment (control plane in your VPC or on-prem) with HSM integration and hardened audit controls. This requires a project-level onboarding (network, entitlement, HA design) and 6–10 week timeline depending on on-prem logistics.

Constraints and gaps to surface in the gap doc:
- SCIM: we support SCIM v2; need to map group attribute names (your team to provide attribute mapping).
- HSM: we integrate with CloudHSM and can accept external HSM via KMIP for private deployments; verify your HSM provider compatibility.
- Immutable logs: platform can write signed log bundles to S3/FTP that you forward into Splunk — retention enforced on your side. If you need platform-level 10-year retention under Redwood's custody, that will require an enterprise retention add-on and a legal agreement.

Action items (owners & dates):
- Sergio: draft gap doc & attach our checklist (due 2026-12-03).
- Monica/CS: draft pilot runbook and resource estimate (due 2026-12-06).
- SableBank: provide SCIM attribute mapping + completed RFI (due 2026-12-04).
- Vivek: prepare brief on KMS/HSM integration options and supported vendors (due 2026-12-05).

I’ll prepare a 20-minute technical slide pack for the 12/8 session covering network, KMS options, SCIM mapping, and logging flow.
